objective: Definir el contrato puro de limites, acumulacion y combinabilidad de beneficios Cavas. Debe evaluar capacidad restante antes de emitir una nueva aplicacion, considerando topes configurables por transaccion, dia, periodo contractual y empresa/unidad, consumo confirmado neto de compensaciones, y reglas de stacking/combinabilidad con otras promociones. No DDL, no escritura directa al POS/ERP, no hardcodes de montos o porcentajes.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BenefitLimitPolicy, BenefitLimitScope, BenefitStackingMode, BenefitUsageSnapshot, evaluate_benefit_limits,
)


def test_monetary_cap_blocks_when_request_exceeds_remaining():
    decision = evaluate_benefit_limits(
        policy=BenefitLimitPolicy("POL-1", "V1", BenefitLimitScope.DAY, monetary_cap=500),
        snapshot=BenefitUsageSnapshot(confirmed_net_amount=450, confirmed_usage_count=1),
        requested_amount=100,
    )
    assert decision.allowed is False
    assert decision.remaining_amount == 50
    assert "MONETARY_CAP_EXCEEDED" in decision.reasons


def test_usage_count_cap_blocks_when_exhausted():
    decision = evaluate_benefit_limits(
        policy=BenefitLimitPolicy("POL-1", "V1", BenefitLimitScope.CONTRACT_PERIOD, usage_count_cap=2),
        snapshot=BenefitUsageSnapshot(confirmed_net_amount=0, confirmed_usage_count=2),
        requested_amount=10,
    )
    assert decision.allowed is False
    assert decision.remaining_uses == 0


def test_exclusive_policy_blocks_with_other_active_promotion():
    decision = evaluate_benefit_limits(
        policy=BenefitLimitPolicy("POL-1", "V1", BenefitLimitScope.TRANSACTION, stacking_mode=BenefitStackingMode.EXCLUSIVE),
        snapshot=BenefitUsageSnapshot(0, 0, active_promotion_ids=("PROMO-X",)),
        requested_amount=50,
    )
    assert decision.allowed is False
    assert "OTHER_PROMOTION_ACTIVE" in decision.reasons


def test_stackable_policy_allows_other_promotions_when_caps_allow():
    decision = evaluate_benefit_limits(
        policy=BenefitLimitPolicy("POL-1", "V1", BenefitLimitScope.TRANSACTION, monetary_cap=1000, stacking_mode=BenefitStackingMode.STACKABLE),
        snapshot=BenefitUsageSnapshot(100, 1, active_promotion_ids=("PROMO-X",)),
        requested_amount=50,
    )
    assert decision.allowed is True


def test_same_policy_only_rejects_different_policy():
    decision = evaluate_benefit_limits(
        policy=BenefitLimitPolicy("POL-1", "V1", BenefitLimitScope.DAY, stacking_mode=BenefitStackingMode.SAME_POLICY_ONLY),
        snapshot=BenefitUsageSnapshot(0, 0, active_policy_ids=("POL-2",)),
        requested_amount=10,
    )
    assert decision.allowed is False
    assert "INCOMPATIBLE_POLICY_STACK" in decision.reasons

constraints: NO hardcodes de topes, montos, porcentajes o periodicidades
El acumulado se basa en beneficios confirmados netos de compensaciones confirmadas
La evaluacion ocurre antes de emitir una nueva instruccion de beneficio
No duplicar motores de promociones existentes si posteriormente se identifica uno canonico
Las reglas de combinabilidad son configurables por politica/version
